(You can also read more about [hangovers](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13ZpxR8X0eLX7e4FAFAZ6KphzM6foQzs48MDVpHbfmNY9wbtZZVfY_Ut_jvRXyIDpB62vxEr-NdzTk9W1fls4f3f8rMQaWdXq6KfwTEiA20E0HCfDRwoPzbEEnrfkR71E3iBqwzpCEDk_Zyp17Q7HXNXHyTJDEx7QHWRgjZTGna7kx5_MhMhdydxIt4) from the Mayo Clinic or compare [food poisoning and hangovers](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF16j_J8-W_c5qOMowagbBH0xuQpt9tpofUsTje4sCG-RdcAXajWqELGTMPuY7DmDquiQlf9zflvmybl5JQDyIXXKdIpp8qNQnYjt1pw15ta0MEzEEhqc4S-9lUw6LEKiLwudb-kG8Qzvsz_w1VHkr0LHTfQiDLsgR3EWt9zg1SnGIYWjBPaCo4ZhSYGwoHtnJWPPZItOZvhKI4ONU).)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF11IxfMH91oB43qYTmhjBiKIPnKacF2hjD3A1Mpq4npP21GFhOlOexPo69s3Sse6gPgUUdm7pJsyGW__VKibGWzT9qerm6OUsLIOJqG-IIZHpdl6bLekfxzfQL8lC6aSmLEPpCTPj_N-er1MJtWaNJzvxwf1FPPHPZflJIG8YYTb6vI6EiDnxxhChdw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF178_6vYxyQRM40vzH-H9xnRHHe1wfN9E3-hLzFZbvRcZBrY645369M91pIzFBSZ0aZNRcEA5o0USuom5OAvo7180zbyle_C9tA8njYAaAh3OxCQVqFq_7UBdiF39oyY9kz617NrnZEeUibifYD2nGq0hr5Tjid3GJJekUJV_h4lWvc0o417OcxvIfZa8UmVmkoRlYwgp5HWKnlQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXJVIQNNvXTq6fkpvRjlBpw4SoRP9yGpMtjyZb7WLm6T_7ovu9FrcX0odLTvowZpXPCU_DwdHEccYGFkUJuIcfKNGw9QPT4tKKxVFtYv5aO3Vsu7Ethd0759v2O2226tGHqiRkAl-mvidfBeg3dT9R8sB5ASDQtPpUsQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13ZpxR8X0eLX7e4FAFAZ6KphzM6foQzs48MDVpHbfmNY9wbtZZVfY_Ut_jvRXyIDpB62vxEr-NdzTk9W1fls4f3f8rMQaWdXq6KfwTEiA20E0HCfDRwoPzbEEnrfkR71E3iBqwzpCEDk_Zyp17Q7HXNXHyTJDEx7QHWRgjZTGna7kx5_MhMhdydxIt4)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF16j_J8-W_c5qOMowagbBH0xuQpt9tpofUsTje4sCG-RdcAXajWqELGTMPuY7DmDquiQlf9zflvmybl5JQDyIXXKdIpp8qNQnYjt1pw15ta0MEzEEhqc4S-9lUw6LEKiLwudb-kG8Qzvsz_w1VHkr0LHTfQiDLsgR3EWt9zg1SnGIYWjBPaCo4ZhSYGwoHtnJWPPZItOZvhKI4ONU)
- **Watch for Emergencies:** If someone has been drinking heavily, severe confusion, trouble waking up, slowed or irregular breathing, seizures, or cold, pale, or bluish skin can signal **alcohol poisoning** —a medical emergency requiring immediate 911 care. Seek prompt medical care for food poisoning if you cannot keep liquids down, see signs of severe dehydration, have a high fever, or notice bloody stools.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXzSyvXgN89MfljJWuPJOKjwana9RFWj6hQuLUi2eH1RibhzpiTQvbgCdekKMMTS7hFFSzo0PhZM_gx8gbo5F-_GdRVpqSoPLfAPwqKUyKq4au-byOHhA_PH4JB0EZPwvkfdj3SPzA9Y86FsnsstdQ0Z1qT01cs04C3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXJVIQNNvXTq6fkpvRjlBpw4SoRP9yGpMtjyZb7WLm6T_7ovu9FrcX0odLTvowZpXPCU_DwdHEccYGFkUJuIcfKNGw9QPT4tKKxVFtYv5aO3Vsu7Ethd0759v2O2226tGHqiRkAl-mvidfBeg3dT9R8sB5ASDQtPpUsQ)
